verdict.rationale: Luma publishes per-model, per-resolution credit costs, so a marketer can work out a generation's cost in advance (e.g. 20 credits for a 5s Draft T2V/I2V clip). Its docs also link a Billing Dashboard for spend after the fact. However, there is no evidence of an in-product pre-run cost estimate or of what the dashboard actually shows for spend tracking. Missing for 10: per-generation cost preview before submitting, documented spend/usage history detail (per-generation or per-period), credit-to-dollar conversion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: The Luma API uses a credit system, not a subscription.
